tagline: An open-source startup operating school for technical founders — functional curricula × role pathways × startup stages.
overview: This org covers **turning it into a company** — the operating knowledge technical founders need: how startups work as a system, customer discovery and product-market fit, go-to-market, finance and fundraising, operations and governance, and the endgame. Each curriculum is one self-contained repository, and you learn by building real **founder artifacts**, not reading case studies.
highlights: 🧭 Start with **Startup Foundations**, then follow your role pathway

sections.heading: 🧭 The Three-Axis Model
sections.body:
Startup knowledge is organized on three axes, not one — every module is tagged against all three. See **[startup-foundations](https://github.com/ai-startup-curriculum/startup-foundations)** for the canonical model.

1. **Functional curricula** — the deep bodies of knowledge, authored once (Foundations → Customer Discovery → PMF → GTM → Sales → Growth; Corporate Structure → Equity / Governance / Fundraising; Economics → Modeling / Runway / Unit Economics). See the [dependency graph](https://github.com/ai-startup-curriculum/startup-foundations/blob/main/FUNCTIONAL_CURRICULA.md).
2. **Role pathways** — curated views over the functional curricula (Founder/CEO, CTO, Product & GTM…), each declaring target coverage so a lesson is never rewritten six times.
3. **Startup stages** — `IDEA → PRE-SEED → SEED → SERIES-A → GROWTH → MATURE`, so the curriculum tells you what matters *now* and what to ignore. See [STARTUP_STAGES](https://github.com/ai-startup-curriculum/startup-foundations/blob/main/STARTUP_STAGES.md).

track_note: Curricula are listed in path order for the autonomous pipeline; this is **not** a seniority ladder — a founding PM is not "junior" to a CTO. **Start with [startup-foundations](https://github.com/ai-startup-curriculum/startup-foundations)**, then follow your role pathway.

focus.startup-foundations: How startups work as a system, the dependency graph, stages, founder operating basics, reading the numbers
focus.founder-ceo: Customer discovery, business modeling, runway, pre-seed to seed fundraising, SAFEs & cap tables, founder-led sales
focus.cto: Architecture under uncertainty, build vs. buy, first engineering hires, tech debt as a business decision, scaling
focus.startup-product-gtm: Problem validation, PMF signals, positioning, ICP, founder-led sales, pricing & packaging, demand generation
focus.cpo: Discovery to PMF, prioritization, outcome roadmaps, discovery/delivery cadence, experimentation & AI evals
focus.startup-finance-fundraising: Startup accounting, unit economics, three-statement forecasting, cap tables, convertibles, valuation, fundraising
focus.startup-operations-governance: Entity formation, founder legal architecture, employment law, HR ops, equity-comp policy, compensation
focus.startup-exit: Endgame strategy, M&A structures & acquirer motivations, LOIs, diligence & data rooms, secondaries

technologies.Validation: Customer-discovery interview plans, PMF measurement, ICP and positioning docs
technologies.Finance: Runway models, three-statement and driver-based forecasts, unit-economics and cohort models
technologies.Equity & fundraising: Cap tables, SAFE and convertible scenarios, investor funnels
technologies.Operations & governance: Entity and founder agreements, equity-comp policy, board packets
technologies.Exit: Deal-structure comparisons, LOI term reviews, diligence data rooms
